title: po.proposed
description: LIVE RAIL (addressed event). The buyer proposes terms to a seller; the agreements substrate holds both stamps on one row. thread/terms_hash are peer-shared agreement keys — never location-prefixed.

schema_version.description: Bumped on breaking shape change. Consumers branch on it.

openly_operated.description: Set at emit time from the gerp's settings. The publication rule's filter — a private gerp's events never leave the operator plane.

customer_id.description: Emitting tenant (gerp_id). Redundant with the envelope account id but saves consumers a join.

thread.description: Proposer-generated exchange id — the agreement key.

terms_hash.description: Content fingerprint both sides compute identically.
